sloka: त्वया च सह गन्तव्यम् मया गुरु जन आज्ञया ।त्वद् वियोगेन मे राम त्यक्तव्यम् इह जीवितम् ॥२-२९-५॥
transliteration: tvayā ca saha gantavyam mayā guru jana ājñayā ।tvad viyogena me rāma tyaktavyam iha jīvitam ॥2-29-5॥

translations.english: In accordance with the command of the elders, I must accompany you to the forest. If I am separated from you, I will give up my life here itself.
